biological_reference.divergence: Not a formal-definition import, so the SD-003 formal-import failure mode does not apply. Biology does NOT say the mechanism is wrong; it says the translation is missing a dependency.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint_addendum: EXTEND the authority fix UPSTREAM of E3.select to HippocampalModule._score_trajectory's elite selection, and -- separately and more importantly -- give that stage behavioural THROUGHPUT. V3-EXQ-931 shows the two are independent failures: (a) AUTHORITY -- wanting_authority_ratio ~= 0.0037 means the wanting term is ~270x too small to move the CEM argmin at the documented operating weight (first flips w~50, 5/5 seeds w~500); (b) THROUGHPUT -- even at w=5000 with 80% of argmins flipped, mean_resource_proximity is BIT-IDENTICAL to ablation, because REEAgent.select_action (agent.py:5815) re-scores the pool with self.e3.last_scores independently of the CEM's elite pick. Fixing (a) alone buys flipped picks and no behavioural change. The build must either propagate the CEM elite pick into E3's committed selection, or document the CEM elite stage as advisory-only so no future experiment reads a behavioural DV off it. Add a standing readiness assertion generalising the 2026-06-10 amendment by one step: a scoring-layer lever must report the ratio of its own cross-candidate spread to the dominant term's, and that ratio must be COMPETITIVE (not merely nonzero) before any behavioural falsifier is queued.

fanout_recommendation.question: If residue_wanting has no selection authority at the operating weight AND the hippocampal-CEM pick has no behavioural throughput even at full authority, WHY does residue_wanting predict locomotion at t+1 (r=0.373, partial|z_goal +0.432, all 3 seeds)?
live_hypotheses: H1 SHARED-SITUATION: no causal path from wanting to action -- both residue_wanting and locomotion are driven by the same situational/bodily state (residue-field geometry built by the agent's own harm/benefit contact, proximity, drive level), so the lagged correlation is a common-cause signature. Currently the best-supported reading, since 931 excludes the CEM route at two independent points.

H2 ALTERNATIVE-EFFECTOR: a genuine causal path exists but is NOT the pathway 931 ablated -- wanting reaches behaviour via the serotonergic benefit-salience path, drive coupling, or a modulatory channel at E3.select rather than via the hippocampal CEM scoring term. 931 ablated exactly one route and would not see this.

H3 REVERSE / CO-DETERMINATION: the arrow runs the other way within the lag window -- locomotion changes proximity, which changes benefit_exposure, which update_benefit_salience writes into VALENCE_WANTING on the same per-tick cadence, so wanting[t] -> moved[t+1] is partly an artifact of the writer's own update timing rather than a forward-predictive relation.

suggested_probes.sketch: CHEAPEST AND MOST DECISIVE -- 931's own arm structure already contains the discriminator it did not measure. Run 932's coupling instrument INSIDE 931's ARM_W0 vs ARM_W5000 contrast and compare the wanting->moved(t+1) coupling. Declared null: the coupling is statistically indistinguishable between wanting_weight=0 and wanting_weight=5000, which excludes the CEM scoring route directly and leaves H1 and H3. A DIFFERENCE would falsify the current reading and establish an authority-dependent behavioural path.
suggested_probes.declared_null: coupling_wanting_t_to_moved_t1 identical (overlapping CIs) at wanting_weight 0 vs 5000

suggested_probes.sketch: Condition the coupling on matched situations: partial out the situational drivers (resource/hazard proximity, drive level, active-center count, z_harm_norm) as well as z_goal, and report the within-situation-stratum coupling. Declared null: the wanting->moved coupling vanishes once situation is controlled, confirming common-cause.
suggested_probes.declared_null: partial r(wanting, moved | proximity, drive, z_harm, z_goal) < 0.15

suggested_probes.sketch: Cross-lagged panel on the already-recorded per-step data: compare wanting[t] -> moved[t+1] against moved[t] -> wanting[t+1] with the writer cadence explicitly modelled. Declared null: the two directions are symmetric, indicating co-determination by the writer's own update timing rather than forward prediction. NOTE this leg needs NO new compute -- it is computable from the committed 932 episode log.
suggested_probes.declared_null: r(wanting[t], moved[t+1]) approximately equals r(moved[t], wanting[t+1])

learning_extracted: A signal can be live, non-degenerate and behaviourally predictive while having ZERO selection authority. Measuring coupling and measuring authority are different experiments; a PASS on the former says nothing about the latter.

SELECTION AUTHORITY DOES NOT IMPLY BEHAVIOURAL THROUGHPUT. ARM_W5000 flips 80% of CEM argmins with bit-identical resource proximity. Any future experiment manipulating a hippocampal-CEM scoring knob and reading a behavioural DV will return a structural null that LOOKS like a substrate or claim finding. This is the most reusable finding in the cluster.

wanting_authority_ratio (cross-candidate spread of the manipulated term / spread of the dominant term) is a reusable READINESS statistic: ~0.0037 predicts the null directly. This generalises the 2026-06-10 modulatory-bias-selection-authority amendment ('assert cross-candidate range exists') by one step -- assert the range is COMPETITIVE, not merely nonzero, before queuing a behavioural falsifier.

The shipped HippocampalConfig.wanting_weight default is 0.0 (config.py:2055), not 0.5. 'Operating weight' in this lineage means the DOCUMENTED RECOMMENDED value; the stock production configuration runs with this pathway absent, i.e. ARM_W0 IS production.

Multi-arm manifests collapse enabled_default_off_flags LAST-WINS (experiments/_lib/manifest_core.py::enabled_default_off_flags_for_agents, a limitation its own docstring states). 931's top-level block therefore reports hippocampal.wanting_weight = 5000.0 -- the positive-control arm -- for the very field the run manipulates. Ground truth is recoverable from per_arm[*].wanting_weight, so this is a legibility hazard, not an adjudication blocker; but any dose-response driver over a default-off field has it.

This run SUPERSEDES failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-914-914a_2026-08-13's second learning that 'the existing lever (wanting_weight) already covers it' -- the lever does not cover it, because the lever's authority does not propagate to the committed action.

learning_extracted: 'POWERED' IS NOT 'NON-DEGENERATE'. 932 gates every coupling on n >= 200 and reports eight channels powered: true, while two of the eight have a zero-variance DV (approach: 0/1013) and two more sit at 0.6% / 1.0% base rates. A coupling gate needs a POSITIVE-RATE FLOOR on the dependent variable, not just a pair count -- otherwise a degenerate-input 0.0 is published as a measured null.

A MAX-ACROSS-SEEDS non-degeneracy predicate lets 1 of N seeds certify a channel. chan_max_std_z_goal (0.078) passed on seed 2 alone while seeds 0 and 1 were identically zero, and every pooled z_goal statistic in the manifest inherits that. For a channel that GATES a coupling read, the predicate should be MIN across seeds, or per-seed reporting with an explicit N-of-M rule.

REPORT A PARTIAL whenever two candidate drivers are measured in the same run. 932 reports r(residue_wanting, z_goal) = 0.653 in the same manifest as the wanting couplings and partials nothing. The partials cost nothing -- they were recomputed from the committed episode log in minutes, and they changed the reading of three of the four flagged couplings.

GOOD RECORDING CONVERTED A WOULD-BE RE-RUN INTO A RE-ANALYSIS. Because 932 committed a full 1013-step per-step episode log, the partial and per-seed corrections required zero compute. This is the Experimental Recording Standard paying off, and it is why V3-EXQ-932a must not re-run to obtain them -- a blind re-run would reproduce the same blind spot at the same compute cost.

An affect-precedence mode classifier can make a DV structurally unreachable in a saturated regime. approach sits fifth in the chain (freeze > assert > shelter > avoid > approach) and the run is harm-saturated, so it never fires. Same defect CLASS as the dry-run 'structurally unsettable criterion' trap, reached by a different route -- worth a standing check on any precedence-ordered categorical DV, not just on truncated smokes.

931 and 932 sit in radically different z_goal regimes (active_frac 0.996 forced vs 0.0087 emergent). Any cross-run comparison of a z_goal quantity between these two lineages is invalid unless the formation regime is matched.

cluster_pattern.shape: COMPLEMENTARY PAIR, apparent tension resolved -- a causal-necessity ablation (931, FAIL) and an observational coupling measurement (932, PASS) on the SAME signal (residue_wanting / VALENCE_WANTING), run on the same machine class two hours apart, reaching opposite-sounding conclusions that in fact compose into one mechanism.
cluster_pattern.structural_property: residue_wanting is a live, shared UPSTREAM STATE CORRELATE, not a selection input -- and on this substrate nothing at the hippocampal-CEM scoring layer is. Three measured facts must hold simultaneously: (1) at the documented operating weight (0.5) the wanting term never changes the CEM argmin (0/5 seeds), and at the SHIPPED DEFAULT (0.0) the pathway is absent entirely; (2) even forced to full authority (w=5000, 80% argmin flips) executed behaviour is BIT-IDENTICAL to ablation, so the CEM elite pick has no behavioural throughput at all; (3) residue_wanting nonetheless predicts locomotion at t+1 (r=+0.373, partial|z_goal +0.432, all 3 seeds). Fact 2 is decisive: the correlation in fact 3 CANNOT flow through the pathway ablated in fact 1, because that pathway is shown to have no throughput even at 10^4x its documented weight. The causal route is AFFIRMATIVELY EXCLUDED at two independent points, not merely unobserved. Separately, 931 is a FOURTH convergent instance of the already-registered modulatory-bias-selection-authority bottleneck ('scoring-layer signals do not reach the committed argmax'), at a call site one layer UPSTREAM of E3.select that failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-914-914a_2026-08-13 flagged the implemented fix does not reach. 932's instrument defects are a SEPARATE, independent matter and are not part of the structural property.
cluster_pattern.reconciliation_verdict: NOT a contradiction. 931 and 932 are consistent and jointly identify the mechanism. The parent's three candidate readings are adjudicated as follows. (A) 'Correlation without selection authority' -- BEST SUPPORTED, and now with the causal route affirmatively excluded rather than merely unobserved. (B) '932's couplings are confounded by a common driver (e.g. z_goal)' -- TESTED HERE, since the driver computes no partials at all. REJECTED for the load-bearing coupling: wanting -> moved STRENGTHENS under partialling on z_goal (+0.373 -> +0.432) and replicates within every seed. CONFIRMED for the z_goal couplings themselves, which are between-seed artifacts resting on the single seed where z_goal varied at all. The confound hypothesis is right about the wrong channels. (C) '931's operating weight simply sits below the authority threshold' -- TRUE AND NOW QUANTIFIED (wanting_authority_ratio 0.0037; first flips w~50; 5/5 seeds only at w~500) but NOT A DEFEATER, because buying authority buys argmin flips and nothing else: at w=5000, 80% of picks flip and mean_resource_proximity is bit-identical to ablation. Raising the operating weight would change what the CEM picks and not what the organism does.
cluster_pattern.partialling_answer: NO -- 932's couplings are NOT partialled against z_goal, or against anything else. The driver computes no partial correlations anywhere (verified by source read; every coupling is bivariate), despite reporting r(residue_wanting, z_goal) = 0.653 in the same manifest. This autopsy computed the partials from the committed episode log; they are recorded in the companion .md Section 2(c) and summarised in each target's quality note.
cluster_pattern.planning_decision_forced: Two, and they are independent. (1) The hippocampal-CEM scoring layer needs BOTH an authority fix AND a throughput fix, and fixing authority alone is provably useless -- amend modulatory-bias-selection-authority rather than opening a parallel record. (2) 932's coupling instrument needs a non-degeneracy gate, per-seed reporting and partialling before ANY future coupling read from this family can be trusted; without it, an eight-channel 'all powered' table can present two vacuous zeros and two single-seed artifacts as findings.
